Wall ankle rocks|10 / side|Hands on the wall, one foot stepped back. Keep that heel glued down and rock your knee forward over the toes. You should feel it in the calf, not the front of the ankle.
Standing knee circles, hand on a chair|8 / side|Hand on a chair back, lift one knee toward hip height and draw slow circles outward. Stand tall — don't lean away from the working leg.

Wall slides, back and arms against the wall|10|Back against the wall, arms in a goalpost with the backs of the hands touching the wall. Slide them up and down while keeping contact. If the hands lift off, only go as high as they stay.
Standing torso rotations, arms crossed|10 / side|Feet planted, arms crossed over the chest. Rotate your ribcage side to side and let the hips stay still. Smooth and controlled, no ballistic twisting.
Slow chair sit-to-stand|10|Same movement as the exercise but empty-handed and deliberately slow. This is a rehearsal, not a set — stop well short of tired.
